item.title: QTAC Builds SUPER SAR™ Search and Rescue Truck for Sheriff’s Office
item.description: The San Mateo (CA) SUPER SAR is built on a Ford F-550 four-door cab and 4×4 84-inch cab-to-axle (CA) chassis, providing increased compartment length compared to the standard 60-inch CA configuration. item.title: Lawsuits and More Questionable Dots
item.description: There are a number of lawsuits that are getting attention from the press with at least one being a class action. But, before you jump on board, look at what the end game is and if that end game will actually get you your rig faster. Try to connect the dots. It won't be easy.
